name: Proxmox VE & Backup Server
description: Register Proxmox VE hosts or clusters and Proxmox Backup Servers, then give agents scoped, human-approved access through an mcp__cockpit-proxmox__* server. The plugin keeps API tokens private, asks consent once per target for reads, and asks afresh for every action. PBS support covers datastores, backups, tasks, jobs, verify-job starts and garbage collection; it never deletes, prunes or changes backup protection. Self-signed certificates are trusted only after you confirm the shown fingerprint in the plugin settings.
author: Cockpit
